newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Glickman - CRP interest higher than expected.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Glickman - CRP interest higher than expected.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman on Thursday said there had been more interest in the revamped Conservation Reserve Program than the department had expected.
"CRP interest is higher than (USDA) thought it would be," Glickman told reporters before testifying to a House Appropriations subcommittee.
Signup for the land idling program began March 3 and closes March 28.
The department said earlier this week that over 13.5 million acres had been offered for enrollment in the program so far.
Glickman said USDA would make a final decision CRP acres "no later than late May, early June."
USDA previously said it would notify farmers by mid June if their acres had been accepted.
